title: Urban Resilience Project (URP) Myanmar
description: URP endeavors to enhance the resilience of the urban poor, particularly women, by establishing robust community structures and protective mechanisms while reinstating essential services such as WASH, and solid waste management, health and education.

title: UNDP Response to Myanmar Earthquake
description: UNDP response to Myanmar Earthquake focuses on delivering rapid relief, restoring essential services, and supporting community-based recovery efforts that enhance resilience and lay the foundation for long-term development in a highly fragile and complex environment.

title: Social Protection and Resilience for Communities Project
description: Social Protection and Resilience for Communities project aims to address urgent humanitarian needs and mitigate the impact of the earthquake disaster in Myanmar
